study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective observational study
exposure: Mean echogenicity of the puborectalis muscle (measured at rest, in pelvic floor muscle contraction, and during the Valsalva maneuver)
finding: Lower mean echogenicity of the puborectalis muscle in pelvic floor contraction at 12 weeks of gestation is associated with subsequent cesarean delivery due to failure to progress.
mod_finding: Lower mean echogenicity of the puborectalis muscle at 12 weeks gestation was associated with cesarean delivery due to failure to progress.
